scope: V4 phase-1 read-only visual and performance regression baseline

environment.fixedSnapshotRenderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (0x00007D55) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

lighthouse.boundary: TBT is not INP. No Lighthouse value is reported as field INP.

webVitalsAndSceneReady.boundary: Scripted laboratory interactions; not field INP p75.

swiftShader.boundary: Software-rendering compatibility path only; never averaged with Intel Arc.

singleFrameSpector.boundary: Representative single-frame GPU commands; never treated as sustained frame time.

deterministicScreenshots.state: paused at displayed 000.0 degrees crank angle
deterministicScreenshots.instrumentation: Evaluator-only deterministic requestAnimationFrame timestamps; production source unchanged.
deterministicScreenshots.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (0x00007D55) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

browserAcceptance.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (0x00007D55) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

visualFunctional: At 1280x720, all three modes and all six presets remain reachable and produce the expected active state.
The 0-degree paused solid-isometric, section-crank, and xray-combustion frames retain legible differentiated subsystems and labels.
Explode, labels, flows, pause, pointer camera manipulation and five-field part inspection remain functional.
Desktop and 390x844 layouts have no document-level horizontal or vertical overflow; both narrow drawers remain usable.
Application console errors, uncaught page exceptions and WebGL context loss remain zero.

swiftShaderCompatibility.interpretation: Compatibility floor, not an ordinary-computer frame-rate target.

singleFrameSpectorIfTriggered.toleranceRationale: Five-percent ceiling over the measured V3 frame; rerun only if pipeline, material count or draw-call structure changes materially.

startupIfTriggered.method: Same 5+5 cold-cache protocol; a single Lighthouse run cannot replace the median.

limitations: The deterministic screenshot harness controls rAF timestamps only for evaluation and is not product code.
The light browser acceptance sample is a smoke confirmation, not a replacement for the external 30-second sustained runs.
Visual judgments are expert-agent review, not a real-user blind study.
No NVDA or human participant result is inferred.
